items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: I was singing that for J.C. Johnson... I wanted to sing it so that he could make the money.

ctx.x: Oh, no. My mother was a little against that. And then when I would sing "My Particular Man," I was singing that for J.C. Johnson, and I tried to do a good job, so inasmuch as the song was being sung, I wanted to sing it so that he could make the money.
